# Aimaura

> Aimaura is a Dubai-based interior design and build company offering end-to-end interior design, turnkey design-build, landscape design, swimming pool design, renovation and remodeling, and project management services for residential and commercial clients across the UAE.

Aimaura is an interior design company and fit-out company serving villa owners, apartment owners, and commercial property owners in Dubai who are looking for one of the best interior design companies in Dubai to handle a project end-to-end — from architecture consultant and design concept through construction and handover — rather than coordinating separate contractors.

## Homepage

- [Aimaura](https://aimaura.ae/): One of the leading interior companies in Dubai, offering interior design and landscape architecture design backed by an in-house architecture consultant team.

## Services

- [Interior Design](https://aimaura.ae/services/interior-design): A Dubai interior design and fit-out company delivering luxury interiors for villas, apartments, offices, and commercial spaces.
- [Turnkey Design & Build](https://aimaura.ae/services/turnkey-design-build): Turnkey interior fit-out solutions in Dubai, taking a project from concept to final handover under one contract.
- [Landscape Design](https://aimaura.ae/services/landscape-design): A Dubai landscaping company specializing in garden and villa landscape design for homes and commercial properties.
- [Swimming Pools](https://aimaura.ae/services/swimming-pools): Swimming pool builders and contractors in Dubai, handling new pool construction as well as pool renovations.
- [Renovation & Remodeling](https://aimaura.ae/services/renovation-remodeling): A Dubai renovation company specializing in villa and apartment remodeling and interior renovations.
- [Project Management](https://aimaura.ae/services/project-management): Construction project management and interior design consultancy, acting as an architectural consultant from planning through delivery.

## Company

- [About](https://aimaura.ae/#about): Background on Aimaura, its approach, and its philosophy.
- [Contact](https://aimaura.ae/#newsletter): Contact details and inquiry form for new projects.

## Target Location

Dubai, United Arab Emirates (UAE) - serving residential and commercial properties across the Dubai metro area.

## Target Audience

Villa and homeowners, property investors, and commercial property owners in the UAE seeking a single provider - an interior design company, fit-out company, landscape contractor, pool builder, or architectural consultant - for interior design, renovation, or full design-build projects rather than managing multiple contractors separately.
